query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "humanoid-gpt: scaling data and structure for zero-shot motion tracking" computer science
rationale: The paper focuses on human-centered evaluation (trust, usability) of an LLM for business process modeling, which is a distinct domain and construct from the user's question regarding zero-shot motion tracking and humanoid structure scaling. It fails to satisfy any inclusion criteria as it does not measure the same biological/physical mechanism, share the same empirical population (human motion vs. business experts), or provide a baseline for the specific algorithmic properties of motion tracking
